title: The Go pprof debug endpoint is exposed
summary: The Go profiling endpoint is reachable, which returns memory and goroutine dumps that leak internals and can be abused to exhaust the server.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Types of profiles available") and body_contains("goroutine") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Do not expose pprof; bind it to localhost or require authentication.
